decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds directly on the firm's established precast circulation equipment and in-house R&D, so management can interpret early results and refine it, although the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows the firm does reshuffle its automation lineup.

The production analysis software sits close to the firm's control and software expertise and supports its automated, lifecycle-service strategy, so the firm has the related knowledge to absorb feedback and improve it.
